data.name: The Westin Playa Bonita Panama
data.address: Km 6 Camino A Veracruz, Panamá, Provincia de Panamá Oeste, Panama
data.description:
An oceanfront property, this upscale hotel is 3.7 km from Panama Pacific International Airport and 16 km from downtown Panama.
Spanish colonial-style rooms feature scenic views, WiFi (fee), flat-screen TVs, coffeemakers and minibars. Some of the en suite bathrooms offer ocean/rainforest views. Suites add living/dining areas, and the 2-bedroom suite has a kitchenette. Club rooms and all suites feature private balconies and include free breakfast, snacks and drinks in the club lounge.
Amenities include 4 beachfront pools, a private beach, 6 restaurants (including a Latin steakhouse), 3 bars, a spa, 20 meeting rooms and free WiFi in the lobby.
